title: nan
authors: Kang S.; Yoo K.; Ryu K.; Choi S.; Lee J.S.
key_contribution: Presents performance evaluation and algorithms for high-grade Hemispherical Resonator Gyro (HRG)-based INS aided by ZUPT and NHC for land vehicle navigation in fully GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
